title: rubus rosaceus subsp. histrix
intro: Rubus rosaceus subsp. histrix, commonly known as the Himalayan raspberry or wild Himalayan raspberry, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the rose family (Rosaceae). It is primarily used in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its ability to lower blood sugar levels, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Rubus rosaceus subsp. histrix include its anti-diabetic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as phenolic acids, flavonoids, and tannins. The bioactive constituents of this plant are responsible for its medicinal properties, making it a valuable resource for traditional medicine.
